title: Empty Is Not Unreachable: four states a web-reading agent needs, and what happens in the twenty-eight sources that only have two
description: A web-reading agent needs four states, not two. Nothing was there is a result; I could not look is not. This paper probes 40 public sources (28 Indian, 12 not) over two runs plus a browser arm, classifies each into four states (OK, STALE, EMPTY, ERROR or BLOCKED), and documents four shapes of silent failure, two of them found inside programs written to prevent them. Ships the probing scripts, not just the tables.
